item.title: FiiO DM13 portable CD player
item.description: The FiiO DM13 is a portable CD player in a wider wave of young people buying CD players again. First clear signal: July 2024. On the Our misses shelf, replaced in Tech & Gadgets by the Sony MDR-3R.
